items.title: NariQ: BF16-level Qwen3.8-27B in a 10 GB file
items.raw_content:
We built NariQ: 3-bit-or-lower quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B that retain near-BF16 quality across agentic tasks, math, multilingual reasoning, and image understanding. To our knowledge, this is the first 3-bit-or-lower quantization that retains BF16 lvl performance on long-horizon agentic tasks. Benchmarks (BF16 / 3-bit / 2.5-bit / 2-bit): - DeepSWE: 39.8 / 41.0 / 41.9 / 28.6 - Terminal-Bench 2.1: 62.6 / 63.8 / 60.2 / 52.4 - AIME 25+26: 97.7 / 98.3 / 96.5 / 86.0 - MSGM: 94.0 / 93.1 / 91.8 / 90.6 - RealWorldQA: 82.4 / 82.4 / 81.3 / 80.9 Decode speed is comparable to other quants on an RTX PRO 6000. Context-length results below (3-bit / 2.5-bit / 2-bit / Unsloth UD-IQ3_XXS): - 4K: 88.9 / 99.2 / 111.7 / 94.7 - 16K: 84.5 / 93.8 / 105.1 / 89.8 - 64K: 70.7 / 77.5 / 85.0 / 74.8 Running these currently require our llama.cpp fork:
( https://github.com/nari-labs/nari-llama.cpp ) Feedback and questions welcome. We'd love to hear how these perform on your workloads. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50611402 Points: 133 # Comments: 29
items.title_zh: NariQ：把 Qwen3.8-27B 装进 10GB 文件，保持接近 BF16 的水平
items.summary: NariQ offers 3-bit-or-lower quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B that its authors say retain near-BF16 quality on agentic tasks, math, multilingual reasoning and image understanding, with decode speed comparable to other quants on an RTX PRO 6000. Running them requires the team's llama.cpp fork.
